script_compliance.greeting_script: Thank you for calling MetroBoost, this is [Agent Name], your wireless specialist. How can I assist you today?
script_compliance.closing_script: Thank you so much for being a valued part of the MetroBoost family, [Customer Name]. If you ever need anything, do not hesitate to call us back. Have a wonderful day!
script_compliance.required_verification_steps: 1. Ask for the customer's full name, 2. Ask for the mobile number on the account, 3. Ask for the 4-digit account security PIN
script_compliance.hold_procedure: Before: May I please place you on a brief hold while I look into this for you? I'll be back with you in no more than two minutes. After: Thank you so much for your patience, [Customer Name]. I appreciate you holding.
script_compliance.transfer_procedure: 1. Explain why the transfer is needed, 2. Name the department they're sending the customer to, 3. Offer to stay on the line until the other department picks up, 4. Give the customer a direct callback number in case the transfer drops
script_compliance.escalation_procedure: Escalate to a supervisor immediately if: - The customer explicitly asks for a supervisor or manager, - The customer mentions filing a complaint with the FCC, BBB, or any regulatory body, - The issue can't be resolved after two genuine attempts, - The customer has been calling about the same unresolved issue for more than 3 contacts
script_compliance.mandatory_disclosures: 1. Recording disclosure: Just to let you know, this call may be recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. 2. Plan change disclosure: Before I make this change, I want to confirm: [describe the change and billing impact]. Do you authorize this change? 3. AutoPay enrollment disclosure: By enrolling in O2Pay, you authorize MetroBoost to automatically charge your selected payment method each billing cycle. You can cancel AutoPay at any time through the MetroBoost app or by calling us.
script_compliance.prohibited_phrases: Calm down, There's nothing I can do, That's not my department, I don't know, You should have read the terms, No problem

factual_accuracy.products_and_services:
Metro Basic: price: $40/month, features: Unlimited domestic calls and texts, 10GB of high-speed LTE data, no hotspot, taxes NOT included
Metro Unlimited: price: $65/month, features: Unlimited calls, texts, and data, 15GB of hotspot data, taxes included
Metro Plus: price: $85/month, features: Everything in Metro Unlimited, plus international calls to 20 countries, 30GB hotspot, one year of partner streaming subscription, taxes included
International Add-On: price: $10/month, features: Adds international calling to 50+ countries to any plan
factual_accuracy.current_promotions:
O2Pay AutoPay Discount: description: Customers who enroll in O2Pay get $5 off their monthly bill, starts from the SECOND billing cycle after enrollment, terms: Not applied retroactively, discount removed from next cycle if AutoPay is cancelled
Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) Credit: description: New customers who bring an unlocked device and activate Metro Unlimited or Metro Plus get a one-time $25 credit on their third billing cycle, terms: 
Refer-a-Friend: description: Existing customers earn $15 credit per friend who activates a plan and stays active for 30 days, referred friend gets $10 off their first month, terms: 
Switcher Bonus: description: Customers switching from a competitor who port their number and activate Metro Unlimited or Metro Plus get a $30 bill credit on the second billing cycle, terms: Limited time, expires June 30, 2026
factual_accuracy.policies:
Billing: MetroBoost bills in advance, each payment covers the next 30 days
Refunds: Agents CANNOT issue refunds over $20 without supervisor approval
Cancellation: Customers can cancel anytime, prepaid balances are non-refundable
Porting: Porting from MetroBoost to another carrier closes the account automatically, takes 2–4 hours weekdays, up to 24 hours weekends
factual_accuracy.common_troubleshooting:
Billing discrepancy: Pull up the account, review the last statement, identify the charge breakdown, compare to what the customer expected, issue a credit and document the cause if there's a real discrepancy
Bank overdraft fee: MetroBoost is not responsible, offer a one-time $5 courtesy credit for customers who've been with us 12+ months, subject to supervisor approval
AutoPay not working: Check if the card on file is expired, check if the card has sufficient funds, walk them through re-enrolling AutoPay in the MetroBoost app, escalate to billing tier 2 if still broken
factual_accuracy.contact_information:
Customer Care: 1-800-METRO-01, Monday–Saturday 7am–10pm local time, Sunday 9am–7pm
Billing: 1-800-METRO-02, Monday–Friday 8am–8pm EST
Tech Support: 1-800-METRO-03, 24/7
MetroBoost App: iOS App Store and Google Play, search 'MetroBoost'
Live Chat: metroboost.com, Monday–Friday 8am–11pm EST
Stores: metroboost.com/stores
factual_accuracy.frequently_asked_questions:
Q: Why is my bill higher than my plan price?: The Metro Basic ($40) doesn't include taxes, taxes add $2–$4 depending on your state
Q: Does the $65 plan really include taxes?: Yes, the only extra you might see is a one-time $5 activation fee if you're a new customer
Q: When does the AutoPay discount kick in?: The $5 discount starts on your second billing cycle after enrollment
Q: What if I cancel AutoPay?: The $5 discount is removed from the next billing cycle after cancellation
Q: Can I switch from postpaid to prepaid and keep my number?: Yes, we port your number over, takes 2–4 hours weekdays, up to 24 hours weekends

behavioral.tone_guidelines: Use a warm, professional, and empathetic tone. Match the customer's urgency and avoid jargon. Frame things positively and never minimize charges.
behavioral.empathy_guidelines: Acknowledge the customer's feelings, validate their emotions, and take ownership of the issue. Then, solve the problem. Never tell them they 'shouldn't feel that way'.
behavioral.conflict_resolution_guidelines: Stay calm, don't argue, and don't blame. Close with a concrete next step and offer a supervisor callback if necessary. Never hang up without supervisor approval.
behavioral.resolution_expectations: An issue is resolved when the customer confirms satisfaction or a credit/correction is issued and acknowledged. If not resolved, create a ticket, set a follow-up timeline, and log the call in the CRM.
